A0_A1.title: Anna
A0_A1.visualDescription: Young woman with short straight black hair, big brown eyes, wearing a bright red sweater and white sneakers. Friendly, warm smile.

pages.bio: Hi! I am Anna. I am 22 years old. I am tall with short black hair and brown eyes. I like bright clothes!
I usually wear a comfortable red sweater, blue jeans, and clean white sneakers. I always wear a happy smile!

greenFlags: ✓ Easy to recognize in a crowd
redFlags: ✗ Always late because of picking shoes

A0_A1.opener: Hello! I am Anna. Do you like red or blue sweaters?
A0_A1.prompt: Describe Anna using 3 simple words (hair, clothes, height).

A0_A1.title: Marco
A0_A1.visualDescription: Tall young man with curly brown hair, dark beard, green eyes, wearing a green t-shirt, denim jacket, and black glasses.

pages.bio: Hello! My name is Marco. I am 25. I have curly brown hair, green eyes, and a short beard. I wear black glasses.
My style is simple: a dark green t-shirt, blue denim jacket, and black glasses. Very casual and clean.

A0_A1.opener: Hi there! Do you wear glasses or have curly hair?
A0_A1.prompt: What color are Marco's eyes and hair?

A2.title: Elena (Athletic & Wavy Auburn Hair)
A2.visualDescription: Athletic woman with medium shoulder-length wavy auburn hair, hazel eyes, light freckles on her nose, wearing a navy blue striped nautical shirt.

pages.bio: I am Elena, 24. I am medium height with an athletic build. I have wavy auburn hair, hazel eyes, and cute freckles.
I love casual nautical style—navy striped tops, beige shorts, and leather sandals. Ready for beach walks!

greenFlags: ✓ Warm hazel eyes that shine in the sun

A2.opener: Hi! What is your favorite season for outdoor fashion?
A2.prompt: Describe Elena's build, hair color, and clothing style.

A2.title: Liam (Tall & Tailored Suit Style)
A2.visualDescription: Tall 6'2" man with neat dark blonde side-part hair, sharp jawline, wearing a tailored navy blazer and crisp white collar shirt.

pages.bio: I am Liam! 27 years old, tall (6'2"), slim frame with broad shoulders. Short dark blonde hair and a clean-shaven face.
Smart-casual elegance: tailored navy blazers, white oxford shirts, leather watch, and polished brown shoes.

redFlags: ✗ Spends too much on dry cleaning

A2.opener: Hello! Do you prefer dressing up formally or wearing cozy hoodies?
A2.prompt: How tall is Liam and what clothing does he wear?

B1.title: Maya (Boho-Chic & Shoulder-Length Curls)
B1.visualDescription: Artistic woman with voluminous dark brown curly hair, expressive dark eyes, wearing an embroidered bohemian kimono, layered silver rings, and turquoise earrings.

pages.bio: I'm Maya, 26. Distinctive for my expressive dark eyes, sun-kissed tan complexion, and shoulder-length dark brown curly hair.
Bohemian aesthetic: flowing embroidered cardigans, vintage silver jewelry, suede ankle boots, and artistic earthy tones.

B1.opener: Hey! How would you describe your personal aesthetic and fashion philosophy?
B1.prompt: Describe Maya's hairstyle, accessories, and overall aesthetic using descriptive adjectives.

B1.title: Julian (Broad-Shouldered & Rugged Style)
B1.visualDescription: Broad-shouldered man with a trimmed dark beard, sharp jawline, short undercut brown hair, wearing a flannel plaid shirt and leather boots.

pages.bio: I'm Julian, 29. Tall (6'1") with a rugged broad-shouldered frame, well-groomed beard, sharp jawline, and warm brown hazel eyes.
Outdoor lumberjack aesthetic: heavy-duty flannel plaid shirts, dark selvedge denim jeans, and durable leather hiking boots.

B1.opener: Greetings! Do you favor a clean-cut corporate look or an outdoor rugged style?
B1.prompt: Analyze Julian's physical frame, grooming habits, and clothing choices.

B2.title: Victoria (Statuesque Elegance & Platinum Bob)
B2.visualDescription: Statuesque 5'10" woman with a razor-sharp platinum blonde bob, piercing ice-blue eyes, high cheekbones, wearing an asymmetrical black blazer and understated gold hoop earrings.

pages.bio: I'm Victoria, 29. Statuesque frame (5'10") featuring prominent high cheekbones, striking ice-blue eyes, and a precision-cut platinum blonde bob.
High-fashion minimalist tailoring: monochromatic suits, structured blazers, sleek leather boots, and subtle designer accents.

B2.opener: Welcome! How significantly does first impression and sartorial elegance influence your personal perception?
B2.prompt: Examine the stylistic impact of Victoria's minimalist wardrobe, hair structure, and demeanor.

B2.title: Gabriel (Charismatic & Silver-Templed Style)
B2.visualDescription: Charismatic 34-year-old man with distinguished silver-templed dark hair, captivating dimples, wearing a tailored charcoal wool coat and silk scarf.

pages.bio: I'm Gabriel, 34. Athletic height (6'0"), distinguished silver-templed wavy dark hair, warm hazel eyes, and expressive dimples when laughing.
Classic European sophistication: charcoal wool overcoats, tailored cashmere turtlenecks, antique leather loafers, and vintage timepiece.

redFlags: ✗ Takes vintage timepiece care too seriously

B2.opener: Greetings! Do you believe personal style should evolve continuously or anchor to timeless classicism?
B2.prompt: Analyze how Gabriel's physical attributes convey maturity, charisma, and sophistication.
